title: 封裝 X 光電腦斷層檢測
summary: 以四階段、24 步深入X-ray CT 投影、體素與重建偽影；每個技術單元分為建模與證據驗證，包含可重算的教學算例、失效辨識及相關工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps examine x-ray ct projections, voxels and reconstruction artifacts. Each technical unit separates modeling from evidence validation, with reproducible teaching examples, failure diagnosis and related methods.
scope: 公開資料支持的原理與工程判讀課；24 步是學習拆解，不是工廠完整 SOP。數值均為明示假設的教學例；實際材料、設備、驗收門檻須依專案規格。體素尺寸不等於解析度；CT 未見缺陷不表示界面無裂縫，尤其薄而低對比缺陷須用其他方法交叉驗證。
scopeEn: A principles and engineering-interpretation course grounded in public material. The 24 steps are an educational decomposition, not a complete factory SOP. Numbers are labeled hypothetical; actual materials, equipment and acceptance limits require project specifications. Voxel size is not resolution; absent CT contrast does not prove a crack-free interface, especially for thin low-contrast defects.

stages.title: 投影與吸收
stages.description: 本階段處理投影與吸收：依序完成三個技術單元的模型與獨立驗證，將物理主張連到可觀察資料。
stages.descriptionEn: Address projection and absorption through three technical units, each with a model and independent verification linking physical claims to observable evidence.

steps.title: 定義檢測目標
steps.objective: 建立「定義檢測目標」的可檢驗工程模型，說明：空洞、橋接與裂紋的尺度和方向不同，需先說明要檢出的缺陷。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a testable engineering model for define inspection target: Voids, bridges and cracks differ in scale and orientation; define the target first.
steps.instruction: 先在工程筆記畫出本單元的系統邊界、材料或訊號路徑。為每類缺陷列最小關注尺度。 把操作前後的預測分開記錄，標示量綱、固定條件與一項待量測輸入；引用原始來源的適用條件，不把示意圖當實測。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch this unit’s system boundary and material or signal path. List minimum relevant size for each class. Record before/after predictions separately, with dimensions, controlled conditions and one input requiring measurement. Respect source validity conditions and distinguish a schematic from measured evidence.
steps.observation: 觀察焦點：為每類缺陷列最小關注尺度。 只有在控制條件一致且差異大於量測不確定度時，才把差異歸於所討論的機制。
steps.observationEn: Observation focus: List minimum relevant size for each class. Attribute differences to the mechanism only with matched controls and differences distinguishable from measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：更小體素必定有同等更高解析度。本步先檢查「定義檢測目標」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到空洞、橋接與裂紋的尺度和方向不同，需先說明要檢出的缺陷。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: Smaller voxels always give proportionally higher resolution. First check whether evidence for define inspection target actually supports the mechanism. If not, revisit the physical constraint: Voids, bridges and cracks differ in scale and orientation; define the target first.
steps.check: 交付「定義檢測目標」模型與比較圖，至少包含本步指定的操作、預測方向、量測單位及未驗證假設。
steps.checkEn: Submit the model and comparison for define inspection target, including the specified action, predicted direction, units and an unvalidated assumption.

steps.title: 定義檢測目標：反證與驗收

steps.instruction: 沿用上一步模型，但先寫下什麼結果會推翻它。為每類缺陷列最小關注尺度。 加入一組對照或重複量測，改變一個會造成混淆的條件，將觀察分為支持、矛盾及仍不足。若只有模擬資料，清楚標成模擬，並指定下一項實物驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous model, first specifying what result would refute it. List minimum relevant size for each class. Add a control or repeated measurement, vary one confounder, and classify observations as supporting, conflicting or insufficient. Label simulated data explicitly and specify the next physical validation.

steps.failure: 需排除的錯判：重建亮環一定是材料實體。本步先檢查「定義檢測目標」的證據是否真的支持機制；若不支持，回到空洞、橋接與裂紋的尺度和方向不同，需先說明要檢出的缺陷。所指出的物理限制。
steps.failureEn: Misinterpretation to reject: A reconstructed bright ring must be real material. First check whether evidence for define inspection target actually supports the mechanism. steps.check: 交付「定義檢測目標」的驗收紀錄：包含指定觀察、誤差來源、能支持的結論與一項應暫緩放行的結果。
steps.checkEn: Submit acceptance evidence for define inspection target: the specified observation, error sources, supported conclusion and one hold condition.
